traits.silhouette: A lean, long-bodied dragon-bird: a long S-curved neck, big feathered wings raised high, two bird legs under the body and a long thin whip of a tail curling up at the end. No front legs. Its body can coil like a serpent, clawed feet clutching its prey (or a moonshine barrel).
traits.head: A bird head with a hooked, razor-sharp beak (black, or pale with teeth), crests of red frills or grey-and-white quill feathers on the crown, and a mass of long crimson tentacles spilling out of the beak like a beard. Either two eyes, or one large round eye in the middle of the forehead as the old Maryland accounts tell it.
traits.limbs: Two scaly bird legs with orange talon feet, clenched as if gripping; feathered wings with long separated primaries.
traits.hide: Smooth green scales on the back, a ribbed, banded ochre underside from throat to tail, a white feather tuft at the chest, feathers on the wings.
traits.colours: Deep green back and wings, ochre-brown wing primaries and belly bands, white chest tuft, crimson tentacles and frills, black beak, orange feet.
child: the tentacles coming out of its beak
